newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Air Force plane crashes in Georgia.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Air Force plane crashes in Georgia.

text.p: A U.S. Air Force F-16 fighter plane crashed at a training range in Georgia Monday and the pilot ejected safely, an Air Force spokeswoman said.
The plane went down in an unpopulated area about seven miles southwest of Pearson, Georgia while enroute from Moody Air Force Base to the Grand Bay bombing range, 2nd Lt. DeDe Halfhill said.
The pilot, 1st Lt. Joseph Thomas, parachuted from the jet and had been located by Air Force personnel.
"The pilot ejected and he appears to be in good condition," she said.
It was uncertain what had caused the crash, she said.
